change.upstreamTerrainOwner: Large World Runtime terrain sampling and grid mesh
change.queryContract: ray origin/direction/maxDistance -> nearest authored heightfield triangle hit with fixed-point point and upward normal
change.algorithm: bounded XZ slab clip plus deterministic grid-cell traversal and Moller-Trumbore intersection over the two authored cell triangles
change.compatibility: non-heightfield fixtures retain the existing bounded AABB ray path; heightfield fixtures no longer report only their enclosing AABB

positiveEvidence: The RSR heightfield ray path returns the authored triangle surface rather than the heightfield AABB top on a sloped 3x3 fixed-point fixture.
A diagonal ray traverses the bounded grid and returns the deterministic interpolated surface point and distance.
The query returns a normalized fixed-point upward surface normal and rejects a ray whose XZ path is outside the heightfield bounds.
The existing Large World -> RSR lowered terrain bridge reaches the same query path without changing source region, stream, chunk or world roots.
negativeEvidence: Heightfield ray queries remain bounded to unrotated static or fixed-rotation kinematic heightfields; dynamic and rotated admission remains rejected.
Heightfield shape cast, swept-volume queries, arbitrary-footprint terrain contact manifolds and dynamic terrain deformation remain open.
Non-heightfield fixtures intentionally retain the existing AABB ray behavior; this change does not claim general exact ray geometry for every fixture type.
No physical device, target GPU frame-rate, Android, external network or production terrain deployment evidence exists.
